entities.summary: Kyŏngguk taejŏn, name translated as the State Code or the National Code, is a code of law that comprises all the laws, customs and decrees of the late Goryeo to early Joseon periods in Korea. Sorted according to the relevant ministries (Yukyo), it had been a basis for over 500 years of Joseon politics.
